errors.quote: In this game against an opponent playing the Alapin Sicilian
errors.reason: The video contains three separate games (starting 0:00, 17:12, 36:38) and only the third is against the Alapin (36:57), so presenting it as one game is wrong.

errors.quote: Black initially developed the knight to C6, aiming for a standard queen takes D4 line
errors.reason: The queen-takes-d4 transposition idea is from the first game (0:07-0:22), not the Alapin game, so details from different games are merged.

errors.quote: faced some tactical challenges and a slightly passive position
errors.reason: In the Alapin game the streamer says he was 'dominating this game' (57:03) and that he missed a win (42:57-43:17), never a passive position.

errors.quote: Black secured a draw through a series of exchanges and positional maneuvering, demonstrating a cautious approach
errors.reason: The draw came after a missed win in a game the streamer dominated (57:00-57:15), and the other two games were won (13:51, 35:44), so the cautious-draw picture is wrong.

errors.quote: Black managed to hold onto an equal endgame
errors.reason: The streamer was dominating the Alapin game (57:03) and aimed for a risk-free endgame (41:35), not just holding equality.

errors.quote: Despite a few moments of pressure
errors.reason: The transcript shows Black applying the pressure on White, with no stretch of Black being under pressure.
